Mary Elizabeth Dean

Preserved Primary Document • dean-m3.htm

Mary Elizabeth Dean was born in Kent Co., DE in 1839. She is listed with her family in the 1850 Kent County, DE Census records. She was the daughter of William Dean and his wife, (Mary) Ann Cork. Mary Elizabeth married James PERKINS , the son of Mitchell Perkins and Sarah Becketts. James was born on 8 January, 1835 in Delaware. Sometime between 1850 and 1860, Mary Elizabeth moved to Michigan. All of her children were born there.
